explanation: The scoreboard had room for only three digits, so her 10.00 appeared as 1.00. She was 14, and scored six more perfect 10s at the Montreal Games.

claims.text: When Nadia Comăneci scored a perfect 10 at the 1976 Olympics, the scoreboard displayed it as 1.00.
The scoreboard did not show her perfect score as 0.10, 9.99 or 10.00.
Nadia Comăneci's score at the 1976 Montreal Olympics was the first perfect 10 in Olympic gymnastics.
The Montreal scoreboard could display only three digits, so a score of 10.00 appeared as 1.00.
Comăneci was 14 at the 1976 Olympics and scored seven perfect 10s there.
